test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment.**

The child was __not guilty of any wrongdoing and lacked knowledge or awareness of wrongdoing.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Innocent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Innocent **means not guilty of any wrongdoing, which is the exact meaning of the underlined segment. (किसी भी गलत काम का दोषी नहीं) • It is a one-word substitute for the given segment. • The word innocent is an adjective that describes the child's state of being. • It is derived from the Latin word 'innocentem' which means 'not harming'. • **Example**: *She was proven innocent in the court of law.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Ignorant **means lacking knowledge or information about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में ज्ञान या जानकारी का अभाव) • **Inexperienced **means lacking experience or skill in a particular field. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में अनुभव या कौशल की कमी) • **Cruel **means causing pain or suffering to others intentionally. (जानबूझकर दूसरों को दर्द या पीड़ा पहुंचाना) 3b:T6ed, The correct answer is: **D, A, B, C.**
